changelog:
**Major upgrade: Adds bilingual, structured interview prep for BA, BI & Data Analyst roles with real-world Q&A and methodology guides.**

- Now supports both Chinese and English for all interview content, including structured templates and sample answers.
- Covers key methodologies (RFM/PSM/DID/K-means), STAR project storytelling, and practical business scenarios.
- Provides common interview question categories with model answers and detailed follow-up strategies.
- Includes salary negotiation tactics and real interview case studies.
- Clear triggers for when the skill activates (any BA/BI/Data Analyst interview prep, project storytelling, methodology explanation requests, etc.).
